statistical_protocol.method: Paired crossed resampling of5 training seeds and class-stratified test examples; same indices for both models
statistical_protocol.interval: 95 percent percentile; no multiple-comparison correction across8 contrasts/conditions
statistical_protocol.declaration: Fixed before checkpoint replay and per-example analysis; AG aggregate scores already seen, so descriptive post-hoc audit, not test-blind preregistration
statistical_protocol.limitations: Five shared-data seeds; fixed encoders, split and hyperparameters; no model-selection or pretraining uncertainty

branch_and_gradient_checks.scope: Two examples, four irregular positive time gaps, three input coordinates, width4; all seven actual recurrence branches
branch_and_gradient_checks.precision: float64 short BPTT with the actual runtime float32 table values promoted to float64
branch_and_gradient_checks.purpose: Finite-difference check of parameter gradients and runtime dependency witnesses; not a global gradient or optimization proof
branch_and_gradient_checks.table_perturbation: Scale selected Call/risk coefficients and endpoints by0.9 solely as a dependency probe; not an alternative financial calibration
